1.explanation:
• Theme/next/Theme.mdx – where all color tokens (including inverse variants) are defined; you’ll add `$link-inverse-hover`/`$link-inverse-active` here.
• Link/Link.mdx & link-avt.md – the Link component docs show how link states map to theme tokens, including inverse contexts.
• Toggletip/next/Toggletip.mdx & Tooltip/Tooltip.mdx – the info icon trigger and arrow call out tooltip-like behavior (this is the container in which the link appears).
• Popover/next/Popover.mdx – explains the pop-over container’s inverse styling, ensuring the new link tokens are applied correctly inside it.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshots illustrate tooltip/pop-over content in both light and dark themes using “inverse” styling (dark background on light themes, light background on dark themes). Inside the pop-over there’s an info icon trigger (Toggletip/Tooltip), a block of body text, a “Learn more” link and a “Button”. The newly proposed tokens `$link-inverse-hover` and `$link-inverse-active` should drive the link’s hover and active colors in these high-contrast inverse contexts, but they have not yet been implemented—so the link is falling back on incorrect or missing colors (e.g. using Gray10 or Blue70 inconsistently).
